name: teams-chat
description: Two-way Microsoft Teams channel via Bot Framework: pipeline notifications + chat commands + freeform chat with Adaptive Card buttons (opt-in; webhook ingress through a tunnel)

configSchema.label: Microsoft App ID
configSchema.help: The bot's Azure app registration (Application/Client ID).

configSchema.label: Tenant ID
configSchema.help: Required for single-tenant apps: the Entra tenant GUID.

configSchema.label: Ingress token
configSchema.help: Any long random string — it becomes part of the public webhook URL (capability URL). e.g. `openssl rand -hex 24`.

configSchema.label: Notify conversation IDs
configSchema.help: Comma-separated Teams conversation IDs for notifications. Send any command (e.g. `/whoami`) to the bot; worca refuses it and Settings → Chat notifications shows 'Ignored /whoami from chat <id>'. That is the conversation ID. In a channel, send it in a new post that @mentions the bot: the ID is the channel's (19:…@thread.tacv2), the same for every post.

configSchema.label: Allowed conversation IDs (commands)
configSchema.help: Comma-separated conversation IDs allowed to send commands. EMPTY = nobody: anyone in an allowed conversation controls worca-cc.

configSchema.label: Allowed user IDs (optional)
configSchema.help: Comma-separated Entra object IDs (aadObjectId) of the people. When set, only these people may send commands, even in an allowed chat; others are ignored. EMPTY = everyone in an allowed chat. In a group chat, /direct and the answer commands are only accepted from these people.

configSchema.label: /direct and answers in group chats
configSchema.help: /direct, /answer, /approve, /retry, /abort and /cancel steer a live run. listed users (default): in a group chat, only Allowed user IDs may use them (nobody when that is empty); direct messages to the bot always work. anyone: every member of an allowed group chat may.

configSchema.label: Freeform chat
configSchema.help: on: a new post in an Allowed channel that @mentions the bot opens a conversation in that post's replies, where a listed member chats with worca's Ask engine (paid model turns). Every reply must @mention the bot. Channels only. Needs Freeform chat members. off (default): commands and notifications only.

configSchema.label: Freeform chat members
configSchema.help: Comma- or newline-separated entraObjectId=worca identity pairs, e.g. 8a3e1f2b-1234-4cde-9abc-0123456789ab=ada@example.com (the person's Object ID in Microsoft Entra, the same id as Allowed user IDs). Only these people may start or continue a freeform chat or press its buttons. The identity is who worca records for their chats and runs (use their worca sign-in on a shared deployment, or local).

configSchema.label: Worca address for links (optional)
configSchema.help: Base address for Open in worca buttons, e.g. https://worca.example.com. Empty: messages name the chat instead of linking.
